topic: what Incognito mode does and does not hide
angle: Incognito limits what is saved on your own device. It does not hide your activity from websites, or from the school, employer or ISP that runs your network.

claims.text: Websites you visit, and organizations that manage your network such as a school, employer or internet service provider, may be able to observe your activity in Incognito.
Incognito limits what Chrome saves to your device: after the session ends Chrome does not retain site data or a record of the sites you visited.
